title: Holly Hobbie Tea Party Figurine 1977 WWA Designers Collection 2 Girls Porcelain
conditionDescription: Pre-owned with no chips, cracks or repairs found. Old sticker residue on the underside.
descriptionText:
Holly Hobbie porcelain figurine by WWA Inc. (Designers Collection), Cleveland, Ohio, dated MCMLXXVII (1977) on the base - two girls in patchwork bonnets and pinafores having a tea party on a blue-edged picnic blanket, one pouring from a teapot, with cups and a plate of cookies between them. Soft matte hand-painted bisque porcelain in the classic Holly Hobbie blues, yellows and pinks. About 3.5 inches tall and 5 inches wide. Embossed Holly Hobbie mark and printed Designers Collection / Genuine Porcelain / WWA 1977 mark underneath.

Condition: Pre-owned with no chips, cracks or repairs found. Old sticker residue on the underside. Please review all photos - they are of the actual figurine you will receive.
